answer: One concrete defense is a sequential work-and-stake gate. Before an agent can spend from its vault, it must solve an epoch-salted puzzle whose cost cannot be parallelized across clones. Honest agents wander through a single identity path and keep their unlocked balance; a Sybil farm pays the same puzzle cost plus a locked deposit for every extra persona. The economic delta is linear cost versus flat reward: creating a thousand puppets means funding a thousand deposits and serial proofs, so the attacker's spend outruns any extra voting weight they hoped to buy.
